    ## [HERA VNIR](https://nireos.com/product/hera-vnir/)





    HERA VNIR provides hyperspectral images in the visible and near-infrared range (400 - 1000 nm).



    [Discover more](https://nireos.com/product/hera-vnir/)



    ![HERA VIS hyperspectral camera by NIREOS](https://nireos.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Livello-3.png)

















    ## [HERA SWIR](https://nireos.com/product/hera-swir/)





    HERA SWIR provides hyperspectral images in the shortwave infrared range (900 - 1700 nm).



    [Discover more](https://nireos.com/product/hera-swir/)



    ![HERA SWIR provides spectral imaging in the shortwave infrared range. 900 - 1700 nm.](https://nireos.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Livello-5.png)

















    ## [HERA eSWIR](https://nireos.com/product/hera-eswir/)





    HERA eSWIR provides hyperspectral images in the extended shortwave infrared range (1200 - 2200 nm).



    [Discover more](https://nireos.com/product/hera-eswir/)



    ![HERA eSWIR provides hyperspectral images in the extended shortwave infrared range (1200 - 2200 nm).](https://nireos.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Sfondo-copia.png)

















    ## [HERA VIS-SWIR](https://nireos.com/product/hera-vis-swir/)





    HERA VIS-SWIR provides hyperspectral images from the visible to the shortwave infrared range (400 – 1700 nm).​



    [Discover more](https://nireos.com/product/hera-vis-swir/)



    ![](https://nireos.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/HERA-VIS-SWIR-768x672.png)


  - [GEMINI Interferometers](https://nireos.com/gemini-interferometers/)Close GEMINI InterferometersOpen GEMINI Interferometers



















    ## [GEMINI Interferometer](https://nireos.com/product/gemini-interferometer/)





    GEMINI Interferometer is a highly accurate and reproducible interferometer for Fourier Transform spectroscopy, spanning the UV to MID-IR spectral range.



    [Discover more](https://nireos.com/product/gemini-interferometer/)



    ![Gemini interferometer by Nireos](https://nireos.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Gemini-interferometer-product.png)

















    ## [GEMINI-X Interferometer](https://nireos.com/product/gemini-x-interferometer/)





    GEMINI-X Interferometer is the high aperture evolution of the GEMINI Interferometer, specifically designed for hyperspectral imaging in microscopy.



    [Discover more](https://nireos.com/product/gemini-x-interferometer/)



    ![](https://nireos.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/GEMINI-X-1-768x413.png)

















    ## [GEMINI-2D Interferometer](https://nireos.com/product/gemini-2d-interferometer/)





    GEMINI-2D Interferometer is a compact and ultra-stable interferometer, generating two collinear and phase-locked replicas of the input light, ideal for 2D spectroscopy.



    [Discover more](https://nireos.com/product/gemini-2d-interferometer/)



    ![GEMINI-2D Interferometer. Two-dimensional electronic spectroscopy made easy: GEMINI-2D interferometer delivers stable, robust femtosecond laser pulses for enhanced performance.](https://nireos.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Livello-4.png)

## Main applications

Explore some of the **industrial** and **scientific** applications that can benefit from our **spectroscopy devices**.

[Discover All](https://nireos.com/applications-of-our-broadband-technology/)

## [Time and frequency resolved fluorescence spectroscopy](https://nireos.com/application/time-and-frequency-resolved-fluorescence-spectroscopy/)

Combine spectral and temporal resolution to measure dynamics at all wavelengths and observe how the fluorescence spectrum evolves in time.

[Discover more](https://nireos.com/application/time-and-frequency-resolved-fluorescence-spectroscopy/)

## [Hyperspectral imaging in cultural heritage](https://nireos.com/application/hyperspectral-imaging-cultural-heritage/)

Hyperspectral imaging cameras non-invasively analyze artifacts and artworks, offering detailed insights on composition, condition, and history.

[Discover more](https://nireos.com/application/hyperspectral-imaging-cultural-heritage/)

## [Hyperspectral imaging in food quality control](https://nireos.com/application/food-quality-control/)

Hyperspectral imaging cameras enhance food quality analysis by providing accurate information on samples like meat, fish, fruit, and seeds.

[Discover more](https://nireos.com/application/food-quality-control/)

## [Hyperspectral imaging for drugs identification](https://nireos.com/application/drugs-identification-and-sorting/)

Hyperspectral cameras excel at drugs identification and characterization by detecting chemical variations in the spectral data.

[Discover more](https://nireos.com/application/drugs-identification-and-sorting/)

[Discover All](https://nireos.com/applications/)

## Leading the way in Photonics and Spectroscopy Excellence

Born in 2018 as a spin-off company of the Physics Department of Politecnico di Milano University, we are now a robust and growing company developing **high tech solutions in Spectroscopy and Photonics**.

Our **portfolio** includes GEMINI, a novel **interferometer** for spectroscopy, the HERA **hyperspectral cameras,** the SPIDER, an **a** **mplified broadband detector**, and TRICLOPS, an ultra-broadband **spectrometer**.

Our high tech solutions in Spectroscopy and Photonics are widely employed both in academia and industry.

[About us](https://nireos.com/nireos-innovation-in-spectroscopy-and-photonics/)

## Any questions?

### I’m interested in joining the NIREOS team, how can I apply?

Thank you for your interest in joining our team! Please visit our **[‘Work With Us’ section](https://nireos.com/nireos-innovation-in-spectroscopy-and-photonics/#openings)** for information on current job openings and how to apply.

### I want to join your network of distributors, how can I do that?

Thank you for your interest in joining our network. If you would like to become our partner, please feel free to contact us at **[info@nireos.com](mailto:info@nireos.com)**. In your message, we encourage you to share information about your company, the territories you cover, and your current range of products. Additionally, any other relevant information you think would be helpful for us to know is welcome.

### I’m not sure which product is the most suitable for my case, what can I do?

You can contact us by filling out our [**contact form**](https://nireos.com/contacts/), and we will be glad to discuss your application with you and suggest the best product for your needs.

### Do you want to know more about us and  our high tech solutions in Spectroscopy and Photonics?  Check out our FAQs page

[Discover more](https://nireos.com/faq/)

## Do you have an inquiry?
